min_area_px.description: Mask regions smaller than this many pixels are noise, not objects (default 16).

kind.description: tree, bush, hedge, fence, rock, lamp, bin, bench, sign, planter, flower, grass_tuft or prop. Structures and characters are handled separately and refused.

mask.description: A picture the size of the scene, white where objects of this kind lie, relative to the job file.
